title: Rayon row-tile multithread for B1/B3 dense kernels
description:
## Current

`crates/gf2-core/src/compute/cpu.rs` already has rayon-parallel M4RM/RREF/rank, but the kernels delivered by SB (B1 transpose, B3 tile-reuse multiply) need their parallel scheduling tuned to the new tile shapes.

## Pre-flight check (mandatory before V10)

Run `perf stat -r 10` on the post-SB single-thread kernel. If `cache-misses / instructions` is above a threshold (heuristic: > 1%), the kernel is memory-bound and multithreading will hurt — abort and revert.

## Fix

V10: rayon row-tile parallelism over the post-SB tile shape. Use `rayon::ThreadPoolBuilder` with the project's existing thread-count convention.

## Per-kernel execution protocol

Per A1's protocol, plus:

- Strong-scaling efficiency measured at 1, 2, 4, 8 threads.
- False-sharing check: tile boundaries must align to 64-byte cache lines.

## Depends on

All of SB (B1, B2, B3).

## Success criteria

- [hard] No correctness regression vs. single-threaded path.
- [hard] Strong-scaling efficiency ≥ 70% at 4 threads at the design size class.
- [aspirational] ≥3× total speedup over the post-SB single-thread baseline at 4 threads.
